AI agents execute tasks that deliver tangible results, such as:</span></p>
<ul class="TextStandard__listSpacings--C7jM6 List__bullet--cvv9t"><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Faster cycle times and higher touchless rates through auto‑creating POs, matching invoices, and auditing expenses.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Better savings and compliance by steering users to contracted items, analyzing bids, and capturing early‑payment discounts.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Lower risk through continuous checks that identify duplicates, anomalies, and supplier signals.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Consistent 24/7 productivity that scales without added headcount.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Continuous learning that improves recommendations and efficiency over time.</p></li></ul>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span><a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/innovations.html" target="_self"><span>Learn more about how to build the foundation for AI success.</span></a></span></p>

class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>Autonomous Spend Management is the use of agentic AI, data, and applications in SAP AI agents execute tasks that deliver tangible results, such as:</span></p>
<ul class="TextStandard__listSpacings--C7jM6 List__bullet--cvv9t"><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Faster cycle times and higher touchless rates through auto‑creating POs, matching invoices, and auditing expenses.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Better savings and compliance by steering users to contracted items, analyzing bids, and capturing early‑payment discounts.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Lower risk through continuous checks that identify duplicates, anomalies, and supplier signals.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Consistent 24/7 productivity that scales without added headcount.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Continuous learning that improves recommendations and efficiency over time.</p></li></ul>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span><a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/innovations.html" target="_self"><span>Learn more about how to build the foundation for AI success.</span></a></span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></dd></div></div><div class="" data-component-name="AccordionItem"><div class="" role="listitem"><dt class="AccordionItemCommon__openerWrapper--j_RPs"><button class="AccordionItemCommon__opener--jl1dQ" data-focus="accordionItem" aria-expanded="false"><span class="AccordionItemCommon__arrowIcon--hyQes" aria-hidden="true"><svg height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="slim-arrow-right-1795209343985-tkbq9"><path d="m5.8 13c-.21 0-.42-.08-.58-.25-.31-.32-.29-.83.03-1.13l3.79-3.62-3.79-3.62c-.32-.31-.33-.81-.03-1.13.31-.32.81-.33 1.13-.03l4.4 4.2c.16.15.25.36.25.58s-.09.43-.25.58l-4.4 4.2c-.15.15-.35.22-.55.22z"></path></g></svg></span><h3 class="Headline__root--lKpRX AccordionItemCommon__title--SefAq Headline__headline-xxxs--ix9XF Headline__medium--irDyM Headline__color--A3sZu">How does Autonomous Spend Management support my next-gen SAP Ariba transition?</h3></button></dt><dd class="AccordionItemCommon__slideAccordion--IQzm8"><div class=""><div class=" dx-99b9a40abd2b0fe98e6b2635cf9bd2af289e25ad dx-row6-11-4 textStandard section" data-component-name="TextStandard"><div class="Grid__container--LFiYT TextStandard__root--doEk4 TextStandard__left--OHU7f"><div class="Grid__no-gutters--CKl5Z Grid__row--SkLLf "><div class="Grid__col-12--cMZPy Grid__col-sm-12--JrL2M Grid__col-md-12--tG5nF Grid__col-lg-12--wWsJK Grid__col-xl-12--v6LlR TextStandard__alignmentStart--ZPElv"><div class="TextStandard__content--yeVj7"><div class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>The AI agents you deploy in SAP Ariba solutions today provide immediate efficiencies that lay the foundation for your evolution to Autonomous Spend Management. AI agents execute tasks that deliver tangible results, such as:</span></p>
<ul class="TextStandard__listSpacings--C7jM6 List__bullet--cvv9t"><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Faster cycle times and higher touchless rates through auto‑creating POs, matching invoices, and auditing expenses.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Better savings and compliance by steering users to contracted items, analyzing bids, and capturing early‑payment discounts.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Lower risk through continuous checks that identify duplicates, anomalies, and supplier signals.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Consistent 24/7 productivity that scales without added headcount.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Continuous learning that improves recommendations and efficiency over time.</p></li></ul>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span><a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/innovations.html" target="_self"><span>Learn more about how to build the foundation for AI success.</span></a></span></p>

class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>Autonomous Spend Management is the use of agentic AI, data, and applications in SAP AI agents execute tasks that deliver tangible results, such as:</span></p>
<ul class="TextStandard__listSpacings--C7jM6 List__bullet--cvv9t"><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Faster cycle times and higher touchless rates through auto‑creating POs, matching invoices, and auditing expenses.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Better savings and compliance by steering users to contracted items, analyzing bids, and capturing early‑payment discounts.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Lower risk through continuous checks that identify duplicates, anomalies, and supplier signals.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Consistent 24/7 productivity that scales without added headcount.</p></li><li class="List__item--dF17N"><p class="List__itemText--YpjfM"><span class="List__content--gqTv5" aria-hidden="true"></span>Continuous learning that improves recommendations and efficiency over time.</p></li></ul>
<p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span><a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/innovations.html" target="_self"><span>Learn more about how to build the foundation for AI success.</span></a></span></p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></dd></div></div><div class="" data-component-name="AccordionItem"><div class="" role="listitem"><dt class="AccordionItemCommon__openerWrapper--j_RPs"><button class="AccordionItemCommon__opener--jl1dQ" data-focus="accordionItem" aria-expanded="false"><span class="AccordionItemCommon__arrowIcon--hyQes" aria-hidden="true"><svg height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g id="slim-arrow-right-1795209343985-tkbq9"><path d="m5.8 13c-.21 0-.42-.08-.58-.25-.31-.32-.29-.83.03-1.13l3.79-3.62-3.79-3.62c-.32-.31-.33-.81-.03-1.13.31-.32.81-.33 1.13-.03l4.4 4.2c.16.15.25.36.25.58s-.09.43-.25.58l-4.4 4.2c-.15.15-.35.22-.55.22z"></path></g></svg></span><h3 class="Headline__root--lKpRX AccordionItemCommon__title--SefAq Headline__headline-xxxs--ix9XF Headline__medium--irDyM Headline__color--A3sZu">How does Autonomous Spend Management support my next-gen SAP Ariba transition?</h3></button></dt><dd class="AccordionItemCommon__slideAccordion--IQzm8"><div class=""><div class=" dx-99b9a40abd2b0fe98e6b2635cf9bd2af289e25ad dx-row6-11-4 textStandard section" data-component-name="TextStandard"><div class="Grid__container--LFiYT TextStandard__root--doEk4 TextStandard__left--OHU7f"><div class="Grid__no-gutters--CKl5Z Grid__row--SkLLf "><div class="Grid__col-12--cMZPy Grid__col-sm-12--JrL2M Grid__col-md-12--tG5nF Grid__col-lg-12--wWsJK Grid__col-xl-12--v6LlR TextStandard__alignmentStart--ZPElv"><div class="TextStandard__content--yeVj7"><div class="TextStandard__paragraph--Tbblv"><p class="Body__root--FCOOV Body__body-s--Qs841 Body__color--Aj694"><span>The AI agents you deploy in SAP Ariba solutions today provide immediate efficiencies that lay the foundation for your evolution to Autonomous Spend Management. These agents deliver even greater impact when you transition to <a class="linkComponent Link__normal--oV3V8" tabindex="0" href="//www.sap.com/products/spend-management/smart-source-to-pay-procurement-software.html" target="_self"><span>next-gen SAP Ariba</span></a>, because the SAP Business AI platform and Business Data Cloud significantly sharpen agentic capabilities and decision-making, amplifying the value of everything you've already launched.</span></p>
